goal: Add a backward-compatible PopSG PDF v2 completion contract that records truthful extracted, failed, and skipped terminal outcomes and refreshes only the completed file's search document.
prohibited_actions: Do not start an extraction workload, corpus rebuild, or data backfill.
Do not change or remove the existing complete_style_guide_pdf_text RPC.
Do not apply to preview or production, open or merge a pull request, or touch licensed data.
Do not broaden grants beyond service_role or alter unrelated queue work.
assumptions: Migration 20260905104802 is the current production contract and its existing completion RPC remains callable for staggered clients.
The v2 function can preserve content-identity and active-file refusals without changing the claim function.
A failed result remains transiently reclaimable under the existing maximum-attempt policy, while skipped and extracted results remain terminal until content identity changes.
stop_conditions: Stop if the implementation requires changing claim_style_guide_pdf_text or any database object outside claim 2578.
Stop if existing rows cannot be preserved without a backfill or destructive rewrite.
Stop before preview, external review, pull-request creation, merge, or production promotion until the orchestrator explicitly releases that stage.
